verdicts_or_reports.element: Back navigation after note type swap
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Pressing Back with unsaved text ("gato") after switching note type shows the "Discard current input?" dialog
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After switching Basic -> Cloze with "gato" typed in the first field, Back closes the Add screen immediately with no discard prompt, losing the input. Without a type swap, the prompt appears correctly.
steps: Tap Type spinner, choose Cloze (field text carried over)

harness_replies: Developer: thanks, confirmed and logged. Keep testing the current build.

sign_off.notes: I filed one bug: Back on the Add note screen closes without the discard prompt after a note type swap. The filtered deck criteria dropdown listed all 11 options. The Spanish "This deck" new-card limit of 15 persisted, and French stayed at 20. I did not test note editing or saving, the Preset and Today only limit tabs, or rotation, so coverage is incomplete.
